name: dsh
notes: Pre-patched DeepSeek Harness for native Bionic/Termux, by Vengisk (MIT). Prefer this over patching the official npm package ourselves — see notes/DSH-TERMUX.md. dsh-termux-full.tgz is a flattened tree of 196 @deepseek-ai/* packages with the Android patches already applied, prebuilt node-pty 1.2.0-beta.15 and koffi 3.1.5 for android-arm64 (both 'for Android 24', 0 GLIBC refs), @img/sharp-wasm32 for image work, a @vscode/ripgrep-android-arm64 shim, and --expose-internals on the bin.js shebang. Nine per-package source patches replace our blunt global platform shim: bash shell resolution, session-persistence link(2)->rename(2), subprocess-local android-as-linux, termux-open path/URL opening, native dir picker, workspace archive check, proot sandbox runner, and ripgrep resolution. Verified on 2026-09-30 SM-S911W aarch64 Node 24.18: node-pty spawned a real /dev/pts/1 shell, koffi loaded libc.so (getpid + stat), dsh -V reported 0.1.0-rc.7-termux.1, and 'dsh web' served HTTP 200 in ~15s. Caveats: bundles dsh 0.1.0-rc.7 vs npm latest 0.2.0-rc.2 (two generations behind, and the patches were diffed against 0.1.0-rc.6 so they may not apply to newer trees); sharp is bundled but not actually imported; bubblewrap sandboxing is blocked by Android sepolicy so agent bash commands run unisolated. Lighter alternative: the 367KB dsh-termux.tgz, same patches and natives with a postinstall that fetches dsh (pinned 0.1.0-rc.6, override with DSH_VERSION).
